claims.content: To allow a VMU User to view the Sales History of a particular distributor with summary details.

goal.raw_text: To allow a VMU User to view the Sales History of a particular distributor with summary details.

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU User must be logged in to the system.
The VMU User must have the necessary User Login Permission to view reports.
Distributor Master Information (including unique code, name, address, etc.) must have been captured in the system.
The VMU User double clicks on a distributor in the grid to view the details (e.g. sales).

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User double clicks on a distributor in the grid to view the details (e.g. sales).

claims.content: The VMU User accesses the distributor screen.
The system displays a list of distributors.
The VMU User double clicks on a particular distributor in the grid to view the details (e.g. sales).
The system retrieves the Sales History for the selected distributor.
The system displays the Distributor Name as the Report Header.
The system displays the summary details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty.
If the system detects a duplicate distributor name during data entry, it displays a warning message to have the duplicate name or to change the name.
The VMU User may select to print the distributor master details or the sales history report.
If the VMU User does not have the necessary User Login Permission, the system will not allow the user to view or print the sales history report.
If the VMU User attempts to delete a distributor record that has associated child records (e.g., sales transactions), the system will not allow the deletion.
The Sales History report for the selected distributor is displayed on the screen with the Distributor Name as the Report Header.
The report footer displays summary details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty.
If the VMU User has the necessary User Login Permission, the print option for the sales history report becomes available.
